properties.notes: The site has been allocated, as part of a wider site, as a Sustainable Urban Extension (site allocation policy ERM5) in the Development Management Plan. The wider site has been identified for mixed-use development including residential, open space and either employment (offices and workshops) and/or community space. Its delivery will be subject to DMP Policy MLS1 “Managing land supply.
